title: Single-cell RNA-seq of human PBMCs from patient-coded sample P1, collected before IRE
characteristics_ch1: cell type: peripheral blood mononuclear cells
treatment_protocol_ch1: IRE was performed clinically using the HFMP-01 Compound Steep Pulse Therapeutic Apparatus under ultrasound guidance. Disposable electrodes were positioned to cover the lesion with a 5-10 mm margin. Paired blood samples were collected immediately before treatment and again 7 days after treatment.
growth_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood was collected from patients with clinically localized prostate cancer treated at Tongji Hospital. Each participant contributed paired samples collected immediately before IRE and 7 days after IRE. No ex vivo stimulation was applied before PBMC isolation.
extract_protocol_ch1: Anticoagulated blood was diluted 1:1 with Ca2+/Mg2+-free DPBS plus 2% FBS and layered onto Ficoll-Paque PLUS. Density-gradient centrifugation was performed at 400 x g for 30-40 min at 18-20 C with the brake off. The PBMC interface was collected, diluted with wash buffer, washed, and resuspended as a whole-cell PBMC suspension for library construction.

Whole-cell PBMC suspensions were processed using the Chromium Single Cell 3' Library and Gel Bead Kit v3 (10x Genomics, PN-1000075) with a Chromium Controller. Gel bead-in-emulsion reverse transcription was followed by cDNA recovery, cDNA amplification, SPRI-based cleanup, library construction, sample-index PCR, and size selection. Libraries were quantified by Qubit and assessed on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer before sequencing on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000.
